- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Alter Self|Alter Self]], [[Tools/Spells/Detect Magic|Detect Magic]], [[Tools/Spells/Knock|Knock]], [[Tools/Spells/Mage Armor|Mage Armor]] (included in AC), [[Tools/Spells/Mage Hand|Mage Hand]], [[Tools/Spells/Polymorph|Polymorph]], [[Tools/Spells/Prestidigitation|Prestidigitation]]
- **2/Day:** [[Tools/Spells/Gaseous Form|Gaseous Form]]
- **1/Day:** [[Tools/Spells/Reverse Gravity|Reverse Gravity]]

bonus_actions.name: Slow (2/Day)
bonus_actions.desc: The archmage casts [[Tools/Spells/Slow|Slow]], using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

reactions.name: Protective Magic (3/Day)
reactions.desc: The archmage casts [[Tools/Spells/Counterspell|Counterspell]] or [[Tools/Spells/Shield|Shield]] in response to the spell's trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

sb.name: Venger
sb.senses: Darkvision 120 ft. (unimpeded by magical Darkness), passive Perception 18

traits.name: Fiendish Restoration
traits.desc: If Venger dies, his body dissipates into crimson dust, and he gains a new body in 1d10 days, reviving with all his Hit Points somewhere in one of his lairs.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day, or 4/Day in Lair)
traits.desc: If Venger fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Venger has Advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects.

traits.name: Mounted Adept
traits.desc: While Venger is mounted, he and his mount have Advantage on Dexterity saving throws, and Venger can force an attack targeting his mount to target him instead. Venger can't use this trait if he has the Incapacitated condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Venger makes three attacks, using Crimson Claw or Crimson Blast in any combination.

actions.name: Crimson Claw
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +11, reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) Slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) Fire damage.

actions.name: Crimson Blast
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +11, range 120 ft. Hit: 24 (3d12 + 5) Force damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
Venger casts one of the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 19):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Detect Magic|Detect Magic]], [[Tools/Spells/Invisibility|Invisibility]], [[Tools/Spells/Mage Hand|Mage Hand]], [[Tools/Spells/Silent Image|Silent Image]]
- **2/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Alter Self|Alter Self]], [[Tools/Spells/Contact Other Plane|Contact Other Plane]], [[Tools/Spells/Create Undead|Create Undead]], [[Tools/Spells/Dimension Door|Dimension Door]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Control Weather|Control Weather]], [[Tools/Spells/Imprisonment|Imprisonment]]

bonus_actions.name: Telekinesis (2/Day)
bonus_actions.desc: Venger casts [[Tools/Spells/Telekinesis|Telekinesis]], using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

reactions.name: Protective Magic
reactions.desc: Venger casts [[Tools/Spells/Counterspell|Counterspell]] or [[Tools/Spells/Shield|Shield]] in response to the spell's trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

legendary_actions.name: Booming Censure
legendary_actions.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 19, one creature Venger can see within 60 feet. Failure: 14 (4d6) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition until the end of its next turn. Success: Half damage only.

legendary_actions.name: Crimson Strike
legendary_actions.desc: Venger makes one Crimson Claw or Crimson Blast attack.

legendary_actions.name: Magic-Binding Chains
legendary_actions.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 19, one creature Venger can see within 30 feet. Failure: The target has the Restrained condition until the end of its next turn. While Restrained, the target can't take the Magic action. Failure or Success: Venger can't take this action again until the start of his next turn.

sb.legendary_description: Legendary action uses: 3 (4 in its lair). One can be taken immediately after another creature's turn, and all uses come back at the start of this creature's turn.

sb.name: Vestige Companion
sb.damage_resistances: fire (Fiend only); necrotic (Undead only); radiant (Celestial only)

traits.name: Hit Points
traits.desc: 4 + four times your Warlock level (the vestige has a number of Hit Dice [d6s] equal to your Warlock level)

traits.name: Proficiency Bonus
traits.desc: equals your Proficiency Bonus

traits.name: Pact Bond
traits.desc: Add your Proficiency Bonus to any ability check or saving throw the vestige makes.

actions.name: Vestige's Strike
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: Bonus equals your spell attack modifier, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. Hit: 1d6 + 3 plus your Charisma modifier Fire (Fiend), Necrotic (Undead), or Radiant (Celestial) damage.

bonus_actions.name: Divine Power (1/Day)
bonus_actions.desc:
Your vestige manifests a remnant of its divine power in one of the following ways, based on its form:

- **Cursed Invocation (Undead Only).** The vestige places a curse on a creature you can see within 30 feet of the vestige for 1 minute. While cursed, the target has Disadvantage on attack rolls against you and the vestige.
- **Fiendish Swap (Fiend Only).** If you and the vestige are within 60 feet of each other, you both teleport, swapping places.
- **Healing Touch (Celestial Only).** The vestige touches another creature. The target regains Hit Points equal to 2d8 plus your Charisma modifier and ends one condition on it: Blinded, Deafened, or Poisoned.
